title: Flooded road: turn around, don't drown
metaDesc: Never drive into flood water. 12 inches of moving water can carry away most cars. Turn around and find another way. What to do if water is rising.
first: Never drive or walk into flood water. Turn around and find another way.
Just 12 inches of rushing water can carry away most cars, and 2 feet can carry away SUVs and trucks.
Never drive around barriers that block a flooded road.
You can't tell how deep it is, and the road under the water may be gone.
If water is rising around your car, call 911 and get to higher ground if you can do it safely.
dont: Don't walk into moving water. Just 6 inches can knock an adult down.

steps.t: Wait for the water to go down, or take a different road. Being late is better than being swept away.

call: Call 911 if anyone is caught in water, or a car is stuck in water.

sources.t: National Weather Service: Turn Around Don't Drown
